theorem anonymous_target
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef z₀ e n => (record y xRef z₀ e n).elim
        (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
    let q : E → Measure E := fun y =>
      (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x - ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η))
    let γ : Measure E := stdGaussian E
    let M : E → Measure ((E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ)) := fun y => ((q y).prod γ).prod P
    let tπ : ℝ≥0 := ⟨Real.pi, Real.pi_pos.le⟩
    let μ : Measure E := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J : Measure (E × E) := Measure.map
      (fun z : E × E => (z.1, z.1 + Real.sqrt η • z.2)) (μ.prod γ)
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧
    ∃ Z : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E),
      Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 × (ℕ → ℝ) =>
        Z a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) →
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) →
          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        (¬ ∃ n : ℕ, eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1)) →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ᵐ sample ∂P,
        (∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) ∧
          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a ∧ a.1 ≤ t ∧
          ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n) ∧
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
        Z y xRef z₀ 0 sample = z₀) ∧
      ∃ R : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ (∀ y : E, R y = q y) ∧
      ∃ H : Kernel (E × E) E, IsMarkovKernel H ∧
      (∀ y : E, (H.comap (fun x : E => (y, x)) (by fun_prop)).IsReversible (q y)) ∧
      (∀ y x : E, H (y, x) = Measure.map
        (fun w : (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ) => (Z y w.1.1 (x, w.1.2) tπ w.2).1)
        (M y)) ∧
      (∀ y x : E, Measure.map
        (fun w : (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ) => Z y w.1.1 (x, w.1.2) 0 w.2)
        (M y) = (Measure.dirac x).prod γ) ∧
      (∀ y x : E, ∀ᵐ w ∂M y,
        Z y w.1.1 (x, w.1.2) 0 w.2 = (x, w.1.2) ∧
        ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y w.1.1 (x, w.1.2) (ε w.2) n ≤ (tπ : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (tπ : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y w.1.1 (x, w.1.2) (ε w.2) (n + 1) ∧
          record y w.1.1 (x, w.1.2) (ε w.2) n = Sum.inl a ∧ a.1 ≤ tπ ∧
          ((tπ - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y w.1.1 a.2 (ε w.2 n) ∧
          Z y w.1.1 (x, w.1.2) tπ w.2 = Φ y w.1.1 ((tπ - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      ∃ K : Kernel (E × E) (E × E), IsMarkovKernel K ∧ K.Invariant J ∧
        (∀ z : E × E, K z =
          (ENNReal.ofReal ρ • q ((2 : ℝ) • z.1 - z.2) +
            ENNReal.ofReal (1 - ρ) • H ((2 : ℝ) • z.1 - z.2, z.1)).prod
          (Measure.dirac ((2 : ℝ) • z.1 - z.2)))
approved_definition_context: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space with canonical volume, including rank zero; gradient is the real Hilbert gradient and fderiv the totalized Frechet derivative. The supplied C2 and Hessian assumptions are literal theorem binders.

Real division by zero is zero; Real.toNNReal is positive part; subtraction in nonnegative reals is truncated. WithTop adds top, untopD 0 returns the finite value or zero for top. Sum.inl is the live time/state record and Sum.inr the stopped record.

Measure.tilted mu h is the probability-normalized exponential tilt: mu.withDensity(x -> ENNReal.ofReal(exp(h(x))/integral exp(h) dmu)); the integral is a totalized real integral. The let definition itself does not assert positivity or finiteness of that normalizer.
hittingAfter f D 0 a is the infimum of nonnegative times t at which f t a lies in D, in WithTop nonnegative reals; the empty infimum is top.

Measure.infinitePi forms the displayed countable product law; expMeasure 1 is the unit-rate exponential probability law on real numbers. Function spaces have the coordinate-product measurable structure; stdGaussian E is centered identity-covariance Gaussian. Product measures use exactly the displayed coordinate order.

Kernel A B is a measurable map from A to measures on B. IsMarkovKernel means every fiber is a probability measure. Kernel.comap i hi precomposes the index with the measurable map i. Measure.map F mu is the measurable-map pushforward; an explicit equality to it is a conclusion, not a law about temporal conditional distributions.

Kernel.IsReversible k mu means: for every pair of measurable sets A,B, the ENNReal set-lintegral of k(x,B) over A with measure mu equals the set-lintegral of k(x,A) over B. It is a measurable-rectangle detailed-balance predicate, not a countable-state singleton assertion.
All almost-everywhere assertions have exactly the displayed parameter scope. The literal let bindings define objects; their presence does not itself prove the properties suggested by their names.

Kernel.Invariant k mu means mu.bind k = mu, equality of measures; it is one-step invariance, not convergence or invariance of another process. Measure.fst is the first marginal. Measure.IsCondKernel nu R means nu.fst compProd R = nu: R disintegrates nu; this predicate alone does not characterize a conditional version pointwise on null marginal fibers.

Scalar multiplication and addition on measures use the displayed nonnegative extended-real weights. In the final product the first factor is the returned position law and the second is the retained auxiliary coordinate.
